import copy,json
from work import evaluate
with open('policy.json') as f: p=json.load(f)
with open('requests.json') as f: rs=json.load(f)
with open('report.json') as f: report=json.load(f)
assert report == [evaluate(r,p) for r in rs]
cases=[
 ({'from':'x','to':'y'},p,{'ok':False,'value':None,'reason':'blocked'}),
 ({'from':'ready','to':'running','role':'wrong','attempts':0},p,{'ok':False,'value':None,'reason':'permission'}),
 ({'from':'failed','to':'ready','attempts':True},p,{'ok':False,'value':None,'reason':'retry_limit'}),
 ({'from':'failed','to':'ready'},p,{'ok':False,'value':None,'reason':'retry_limit'}),
 ({'from':'failed','to':'ready','attempts':-1},p,{'ok':False,'value':None,'reason':'retry_limit'}),
 ({'from':'failed','to':'ready','attempts':0},p,{'ok':True,'value':'ready','reason':'ok'}),
 ({'from':'failed','to':'ready','attempts':1},p,{'ok':True,'value':'ready','reason':'ok'}),
 ({'from':'failed','to':'ready','attempts':2},p,{'ok':False,'value':None,'reason':'retry_limit'}),
 ({'from':'running','to':'done','attempts':'bad'},p,{'ok':True,'value':'done','reason':'ok'}),
]
for r,pol,want in cases:
 rb,pb=copy.deepcopy(r),copy.deepcopy(pol)
 got=evaluate(r,pol)
 assert got==want,(r,got,want)
 assert r==rb and pol==pb
print('all checks passed')
